title: Workers close when main's own command finishes their work, never on a timer
notes:
Why: the user needs data from a worker pane that is still open, and the app has closed it on its own. Today's other failure runs the other way: three review workers stayed open with their cards Done, because a leftover one-hour fallback ScheduleWakeup made them 'paused', and releaseVerdict (src/main/workers/auto-release.ts:49) stops at paused before it checks the card. The user wants the closing driven by main's own commands. It should be automatic, but no new rule goes into any CLAUDE.md or into the main prompt for main to remember.

Design:
1. Remove the timed sweep's releasing: closeFinished / sweep in src/main/workers/session-requests.ts, releaseVerdict's timer reasons (card finished, branch merged, report read plus closeAfterMinutes), the workers.closeAfterMinutes setting and its settings/help/docs. Nothing closes a pane on a timer any more.
2. Close at the points where main finishes the work, through the actions (src/main/actions/pane/, actions-rule-1). Each goes through one shared decision module with a test, saying whether this pane may close now:
   - `pr land <n>` (and the MCP tool, if there is one): after `merged <n> at <sha>`, release the worker pane whose worktree is on that PR's branch. Print it as a line before the verdict, or keep the verdict as the last line: `released 0:2` or `kept 0:2: <why>`. Add `--keep` to merge without releasing.
   - A board move to Done or Cancelled made through the board command or MCP (a card with no branch, e.g. research): release that card's worker pane, same decision, same kept line.
   - `pane finish` and `pane release` stay as they are.
3. The guard, never to close:
   - a pane that has the keyboard (the user is in it or zoomed on it);
   - a pane blocked on a permission question;
   - a pane mid-turn, running a tool or streaming;
   - a pane main did not hand work to;
   - a pane whose agent the user typed into since main last sent it work (user turns are theirs). Check whether the hooks already mark this.
   A pane that is only paused on its own background work (a wakeup, a background CI wait) does close once its work is in, because that work is moot.
4. Since nothing closes on a timer, `pane list` marks a worker whose card is Done/Cancelled or whose branch merged as `done, work in: pane finish <id>`. Reading the list then tells main without any prompt rule. The 'paused 30 minutes without a report' notice must not fire for a worker that already reported by message, or whose work is in.
5. Update mainPrompt (src/main/chat/chat-sessions.ts) and BOARD_INSTRUCTIONS, which today say the app closes a finished worker itself. Say what the commands now do, in fewer words, not more. Update docs/workers (workers-decision-1 and its history) and the hard rules if any rule changes.

Tests: the decision module, each guard, land releasing, land --keep, a Done move releasing, the list mark.
Do not close the three worker panes 0:1–0:3 open now, and never restart the running app.
